payload.name: Mastercard Online PIN example
payload.description: Synthetic physical Mastercard EMV profile with an Online PIN-only CVM list. The reader must support Online PIN at the selected amount, including below its CVM limit.

testScenarios.name: Online PIN purchase below the reader CVM limit
testScenarios.amountNote: For example, use 10 CZK with a 500 CZK reader CVM limit. Enable Online PIN in the reader's below-limit CVM capabilities; a low amount does not add No CVM to this card's list.
testScenarios.pinNote: Enter the test PIN on the terminal when prompted. HCE Test Tool does not verify it; PIN validation depends on the connected test host.
terminalSetup: Enable Mastercard contactless Online PIN, including in the reader's below-limit CVM capabilities.
Start emulation before presenting the phone and read every record advertised by the current AFL.
Import this complete example, select it in the Emulator and start with Card profile defaults. Start emulation before presenting the phone.
knownLimitations: A successful card flow requests online authorization; final approval or decline depends on the connected test host.
The synthetic card validity is 2020-01-01 through 2035-12-31; its ICC certificate authenticates the normalized record data.
The card offers Online PIN only. A reader advertising only No CVM below its limit has no matching CVM; CVM failed is not successful No CVM processing.
A completed card-side flow is not a payment approval. Online PIN and cryptogram authorization belong to the configured test terminal and host.

For CDA, configure the matching synthetic test CA on the reader and request CDA in GENERATE AC. The plain-cryptogram path does not return a CDA signature. Reader support and successful host validation are separate requirements.

Custom application cryptogram keys require the matching diversification PAN, PAN sequence number and dynamic-number key. Keep the default offline-authentication key unless a matching synthetic ICC key/certificate fixture is available. Reset removes temporary overrides and immediately restores this profile’s own defaults; it does not modify the saved profile.

This downloadable example has a separate Profile ID from the Built-in profile. Importing it does not update an existing imported snapshot; keep the original JSON and choose a unique ID for additional copies.
